author: Ryan George Extra Plus!
description:
Get exclusive videos & early access on my Patreon: http://patreon.com/RyanGeorge

Billionaire weddings are a beautiful celebration of love, commitment, and making the entire city of Venice deal with your nonsense.

Today we’re looking at some of the most absurd luxury weddings I could find: Jeff Bezos and Lauren Sanchez shutting down Venice for a reported $50 million extravaganza, David and Victoria Beckham getting married in a castle while dressed like royal grape soda, a billion-dollar oligarch wedding with celebrity performances, and the kind of wedding cakes that seem less edible than legally concerning. The richer the people, the stranger the details get.

There are private jets, purple thrones, giant rotating cakes, yacht foam parties, and at least one wedding where the correct response is not “aww” but “what on earth is happening here.” If you’ve ever been to a normal wedding and thought “this centerpiece is a bit much,” this should help recalibrate your standards immediately.
title: Inside Billionaire Big Dumb Luxury Weddings
